CHARGING
========

CHARGING VIA AC WALL OUTLET
---------------------------

When charging from the wall, this product must be used with |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|.

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 0
   :widths: 12 88

   * - **WARNING**
     - Ensure all products are powered off before connecting |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_SHORT_NAME| to |PRODUCT_NAME|.

.. image:: |BP_CHARGING_AC_ASSET|
   :alt: AC wall charging connection through |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|.
   :width: 100%

CHARGING VIA SOLAR PANELS (SOLD SEPARATELY)
-------------------------------------------

Charge your product with solar panels and |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME| as shown in the figure below. Please refer to the |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME| user manual for more information.

.. image:: |BP_CHARGING_SOLAR_ASSET|
   :alt: Solar charging connection through |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|.
   :width: 500px
